decision_conditions: The development to which this consent relates must be commenced not later than three years from the date of this consent.
To comply with the requirements of Section 18(1) of the Planning (Listed Building and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 (as amended by Section 51 of the Planning Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out otherwise than in complete accordance with the approved plans  (as set out on page one of this decision notice).
For the avoidance of doubt and to ensure that the development is carried out as approved.

The new windows/door which form part of the approved scheme shall match in their entirety the scale, material, dimensions, including thickness of glazing and finish of existing windows/doors in the subject building to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.

To ensure that the design, scale, and detailing of the proposed new windows/door are sympathetic to the character and appearance of the heritage asset, in accordance with Policy 28 of the Local Plan, Policy HC1 of the London Plan and the NPPF.

All new work and works of making good to the retained fabric whether internal or external shall be carried out in accordance with the details submitted within this application and finished to match the existing original work with regard to the methods and materials used, colour, texture and profile and in the case of brickwork facebond and pointing. The works shall be carried out to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
To preserve the character and appearance of the Listed Building and its setting.

Prior to their installation, full details of PV panels located on the flat roofed sections of the building as shown indicatively on approved plans shall be submitted to and agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority. This shall extend to their full specification, exact number, siting and degree of protrusion from the roof of the subject building. Such a scheme as agreed shall then be installed to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and maintained thereafter.
To preserve the character and appearance of the Listed Building and its setting.

Statement Required by Article 35(2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management) Order 2015: No significant problems were identified during the consideration of the application, and therefore it has been determined in accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework.
site_name: Town Hall, Havering LBC Main Road
description: Waterproofing of roof, upgrading of ventilation system, and addition of air conditioning to first floor west wing.
